rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single user. They retrieved the user’s orders, identified the two tablet items, and asked which to return and where to refund. Before making any changes, the agent clearly stated the exact action and requested explicit confirmation. When the user changed their mind, the agent restated the new return details (gold 128GB tablet, refund to gift card) and again asked for confirmation. Only after the user explicitly confirmed did the agent execute the return on the correct order and item with the specified refund method. The tool results show the order status updated to “return requested” with the correct item and gift card ID, and the agent’s final message accurately reflected these results. No unsupported claims or policy violations are evident.
